textos.Entre os que recomendam, cerca de metade: Among those who recommend it, about half highlight the emotional impact generated by the production. On the other hand, most of those who do not recommend it focus their complaints on the script and structure, pointing to a lack of progression in how the story is handled.

textos.Os espectadores apontam que o filme abus: Viewers point out that the film overdoes scenes of nudity and sexual appeal, to the point of sounding more like soft porn than a work with a serious purpose.
textos.As críticas destacam que o roteiro falha: Critics stress that the script fails to develop its premise, making the story obvious, predictable and shallow, with uninteresting characters.
textos.Os espectadores queixam-se de que as crí: Viewers complain that the social criticism about beauty standards and aging is presented explicitly and repeatedly, without subtlety, like a campaign poster.
textos.Vários reviews expressam frustração com: Several reviews express frustration with the ending, which they consider absurd, exaggerated and meaningless, ruining the experience and their impression of the film.

textos.Muitas pessoas acham que o último ato é: Many people think the last act is exaggerated and drawn out, losing the subtlety of the beginning, and that some sequences are so absurd they border on the ridiculous.

textos.Lançado em 2024 e dirigido por Coralie F: Released in 2024 and directed by Coralie Fargeat, The Substance is a horror and science fiction film that follows a declining celebrity who discovers a mysterious compound capable of creating a younger, more perfect version of herself. What at first appears to be a miraculous opportunity to regain her glory soon turns into a disturbing nightmare, bringing irreversible consequences.
textos.A experiência é estruturada em torno do: The experience is structured around explicit body horror and the constant use of practical effects, establishing an atmosphere of strong graphic impact and sensory discomfort throughout the screening.
textos.Em termos de recepção, os grupos converg: In terms of reception, the groups converge on the thematic elements and the aesthetic approach, but disagree directly in their verdict on the result. In the vast majority of ratings (~75%), a significant share stress the metaphor of self-destruction in the face of beauty standards, while a smaller slice praise the performances of Demi Moore and Margaret Qualley and a portion of them emphasize the striking direction and visual identity.
textos.Numa parcela das notas (~18%), na visão: In a share of the ratings (~18%), from the view of those taking a middling stance, a good portion consider the ending exaggerated and frustrating, although several value the social critique of aging and some highlight the work of the cast. In a minimal fraction of the ratings (~7%), from the perspective of this set, many criticize the excess of gore and the gratuitous violence, a portion reject the excessive nudity and a smaller slice point to the lack of development in the script.
